package courseplan

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"sort"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/usecase/pedagogy"
)

type DeterministicResult struct {
	Course            domain.GeneratedCourse
	Fingerprint       string
	NormalizedContext json.RawMessage
	GapTargets        []domain.TargetRef
}

type masteryDecision struct {
	Target        domain.TargetRef `json:"target"`
	Decision      string           `json:"decision"`
	PolicyVersion string           `json:"policy_version"`
}

func BuildDeterministicCourse(
	graph domain.GoalGraph,
	profile domain.StudentPlanningProfile,
	mastery []domain.TargetMastery,
	policy domain.PolicyBundle,
	strategies pedagogy.Registry,
) (DeterministicResult, error) {
	return BuildDeterministicCourseForIntent(graph, profile, mastery, policy, domain.PlanningIntent{
		Source: domain.PlanningSourceSystem, Reason: domain.PlanningReasonInitial,
		DesiredOutcome: graph.Goal.Title,
	}, strategies)
}

func BuildDeterministicCourseForIntent(
	graph domain.GoalGraph,
	profile domain.StudentPlanningProfile,
	mastery []domain.TargetMastery,
	policy domain.PolicyBundle,
	intent domain.PlanningIntent,
	strategies pedagogy.Registry,
) (DeterministicResult, error) {
	normalizedGraph, err := domain.NormalizeGoalGraph(graph)
	if err != nil {
		return DeterministicResult{}, err
	}
	normalizedProfile, err := domain.NormalizeStudentPlanningProfile(profile)
	if err != nil || normalizedProfile.GoalCode != normalizedGraph.Goal.Code {
		return DeterministicResult{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	normalizedPolicy, err := domain.NormalizePolicyBundle(policy)
	if err != nil {
		return DeterministicResult{}, err
	}
	if _, err := domain.NormalizePlanningIntent(intent); err != nil {
		return DeterministicResult{}, err
	}
	orderedTargets, err := domain.OrderGoalTargets(normalizedGraph.Targets)
	if err != nil {
		return DeterministicResult{}, err
	}
	masteryByTarget, err := indexMastery(orderedTargets, mastery)
	if err != nil {
		return DeterministicResult{}, err
	}

	gap := make([]domain.LearningTarget, 0, len(orderedTargets))
	gapRefs := make([]domain.TargetRef, 0, len(orderedTargets))
	decisions := make([]masteryDecision, 0, len(orderedTargets))
	for _, target := range orderedTargets {
		projection := masteryByTarget[domain.TargetIdentity(target.Ref)]
		if projection.State == domain.MasteryMastered && projection.Confidence >= normalizedPolicy.MasterySkipConfidence {
			decisions = append(decisions, masteryDecision{
				Target: target.Ref, Decision: "SKIP", PolicyVersion: projection.PolicyVersion,
			})
			continue
		}
		decisions = append(decisions, masteryDecision{
			Target: target.Ref, Decision: "INCLUDE", PolicyVersion: projection.PolicyVersion,
		})
		gap = append(gap, target)
		gapRefs = append(gapRefs, target.Ref)
	}
	transitions := applicableTransitions(normalizedGraph.Transitions, normalizedProfile.KnownStacks, gapRefs)
	contextJSON, fingerprint, err := courseFingerprint(
		normalizedGraph, normalizedProfile, decisions, gapRefs, transitions, normalizedPolicy,
	)
	if err != nil {
		return DeterministicResult{}, err
	}
	course, err := buildGeneratedCourse(
		normalizedGraph, normalizedProfile, gap, transitions, normalizedPolicy, fingerprint, strategies,
	)
	if err != nil {
		return DeterministicResult{}, err
	}
	return DeterministicResult{
		Course: course, Fingerprint: fingerprint, NormalizedContext: contextJSON, GapTargets: gapRefs,
	}, nil
}

// BuildDeterministicCourseForDiagnosticRoute preserves the ordinary graph and
// mastery decision path. A route only names versioned entry pedagogy in the
// fingerprint/context; the opaque diagnostic plan ID never participates.
func BuildDeterministicCourseForDiagnosticRoute(graph domain.GoalGraph, profile domain.StudentPlanningProfile, mastery []domain.TargetMastery, policy domain.PolicyBundle, intent domain.PlanningIntent, route string, strategies pedagogy.Registry) (DeterministicResult, error) {
	result, err := BuildDeterministicCourseForIntent(graph, profile, mastery, policy, intent, strategies)
	if err != nil || route == "" {
		return result, err
	}
	if route != "START_FOUNDATION" && route != "START_CORE" && route != "START_ADVANCED" {
		return DeterministicResult{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	var context map[string]any
	if err := json.Unmarshal(result.NormalizedContext, &context); err != nil {
		return DeterministicResult{}, err
	}
	context["diagnostic_entry_route_policy"] = "diagnostic-placement-route-v1"
	context["diagnostic_entry_route"] = route
	raw, err := json.Marshal(context)
	if err != nil {
		return DeterministicResult{}, err
	}
	sum := sha256.Sum256(raw)
	result.Fingerprint = hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
	result.NormalizedContext = raw
	result.Course.Fingerprint = result.Fingerprint
	for mi := range result.Course.Modules {
		for si := range result.Course.Modules[mi].Sections {
			for li := range result.Course.Modules[mi].Sections[si].Lessons {
				l := &result.Course.Modules[mi].Sections[si].Lessons[li]
				l.PedagogyStrategies = routeStrategies(l.PedagogyStrategies, route)
			}
		}
	}
	return result, nil
}
func routeStrategies(in []domain.PedagogyStrategyRef, route string) []domain.PedagogyStrategyRef {
	find := func(code string) (domain.PedagogyStrategyRef, bool) {
		for _, v := range in {
			if v.Code == code {
				return v, true
			}
		}
		return domain.PedagogyStrategyRef{}, false
	}
	out := make([]domain.PedagogyStrategyRef, 0, len(in))
	add := func(code string) {
		if v, ok := find(code); ok {
			out = append(out, v)
		}
	}
	switch route {
	case "START_FOUNDATION":
		add("explicit_instruction")
		add("retrieval_practice")
	case "START_CORE":
		add("retrieval_practice")
		add("explicit_instruction")
	case "START_ADVANCED":
		add("retrieval_practice")
		add("prior_knowledge_bridge")
		add("compare_contrast")
	}
	for _, v := range in {
		seen := false
		for _, existing := range out {
			if existing.Code == v.Code && existing.Version == v.Version {
				seen = true
			}
		}
		if !seen && !(route == "START_ADVANCED" && v.Code == "explicit_instruction") {
			out = append(out, v)
		}
	}
	if len(out) == 0 {
		return in
	}
	return out
}

func indexMastery(
	targets []domain.LearningTarget,
	inputs []domain.TargetMastery,
) (map[string]domain.TargetMastery, error) {
	if len(inputs) != len(targets) {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	allowed := make(map[string]struct{}, len(targets))
	for _, target := range targets {
		allowed[domain.TargetIdentity(target.Ref)] = struct{}{}
	}
	byTarget := make(map[string]domain.TargetMastery, len(inputs))
	for _, input := range inputs {
		normalized, err := domain.NormalizeTargetMastery(input)
		identity := domain.TargetIdentity(normalized.Target)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if _, exists := allowed[identity]; !exists {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		if _, duplicate := byTarget[identity]; duplicate {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		byTarget[identity] = normalized
	}
	if len(byTarget) != len(targets) {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return byTarget, nil
}

func applicableTransitions(
	inputs []domain.TransitionKnowledge,
	knownStacks []string,
	gap []domain.TargetRef,
) []domain.TransitionKnowledge {
	stackSet := make(map[string]struct{}, len(knownStacks))
	for _, stack := range knownStacks {
		stackSet[stack] = struct{}{}
	}
	gapSet := make(map[string]struct{}, len(gap))
	for _, target := range gap {
		gapSet[domain.TargetIdentity(target)] = struct{}{}
	}
	result := make([]domain.TransitionKnowledge, 0)
	for _, input := range inputs {
		_, hasStack := stackSet[input.SourceStack]
		_, hasGap := gapSet[domain.TargetIdentity(input.Target)]
		if hasStack && hasGap {
			result = append(result, input)
		}
	}
	sort.Slice(result, func(left, right int) bool {
		leftIdentity := result[left].SourceStack + "\x00" + domain.TargetIdentity(result[left].Target)
		rightIdentity := result[right].SourceStack + "\x00" + domain.TargetIdentity(result[right].Target)
		return leftIdentity < rightIdentity
	})
	return result
}

func courseFingerprint(
	graph domain.GoalGraph,
	profile domain.StudentPlanningProfile,
	mastery []masteryDecision,
	gap []domain.TargetRef,
	transitions []domain.TransitionKnowledge,
	policy domain.PolicyBundle,
) (json.RawMessage, string, error) {
	input := struct {
		FingerprintVersion string                       `json:"fingerprint_version"`
		GoalCode           string                       `json:"goal_code"`
		GoalVersion        string                       `json:"goal_version"`
		GraphVersion       string                       `json:"graph_version"`
		ProfileVersion     string                       `json:"profile_version"`
		DirectionCode      string                       `json:"direction_code"`
		Experience         string                       `json:"self_assessed_experience"`
		KnownStacks        []string                     `json:"known_stacks"`
		DesiredStacks      []string                     `json:"desired_stacks"`
		Language           string                       `json:"language"`
		Mastery            []masteryDecision            `json:"mastery"`
		Gap                []domain.TargetRef           `json:"gap"`
		Transitions        []domain.TransitionKnowledge `json:"transitions"`
		PlannerVersion     string                       `json:"planner_version"`
		PedagogyProfile    string                       `json:"pedagogy_profile"`
		PresentationStyle  string                       `json:"presentation_style"`
		GenerationPolicy   string                       `json:"generation_policy"`
	}{
		FingerprintVersion: domain.CourseFingerprintVersion,
		GoalCode:           graph.Goal.Code, GoalVersion: graph.Goal.Version, GraphVersion: graph.Goal.GraphVersion,
		ProfileVersion: profile.ProfileVersion, DirectionCode: profile.DirectionCode,
		Experience:    profile.SelfAssessedExperience,
		KnownStacks:   append([]string(nil), profile.KnownStacks...),
		DesiredStacks: append([]string(nil), profile.DesiredStacks...), Language: profile.PreferredLanguage,
		Mastery: mastery, Gap: append([]domain.TargetRef(nil), gap...), Transitions: transitions,
		PlannerVersion: policy.PlannerVersion, PedagogyProfile: policy.PedagogyProfile,
		PresentationStyle: policy.PresentationStyle, GenerationPolicy: policy.GenerationPolicy,
	}
	payload, err := json.Marshal(input)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, "", err
	}
	digest := sha256.Sum256(payload)
	return payload, hex.EncodeToString(digest[:]), nil
}

func buildGeneratedCourse(
	graph domain.GoalGraph,
	profile domain.StudentPlanningProfile,
	targets []domain.LearningTarget,
	transitions []domain.TransitionKnowledge,
	policy domain.PolicyBundle,
	fingerprint string,
	strategies pedagogy.Registry,
) (domain.GeneratedCourse, error) {
	type sectionKey struct{ module, section string }
	type lessonKey struct{ module, section, lesson string }
	moduleIndex := make(map[string]int)
	sectionIndex := make(map[sectionKey]int)
	lessonIndex := make(map[lessonKey]int)
	modules := make([]domain.PlannedModule, 0)
	for _, target := range targets {
		currentModuleIndex, moduleExists := moduleIndex[target.ModuleCode]
		if !moduleExists {
			currentModuleIndex = len(modules)
			moduleIndex[target.ModuleCode] = currentModuleIndex
			modules = append(modules, domain.PlannedModule{
				Code: target.ModuleCode, Title: target.ModuleTitle, Order: target.ModuleOrder,
				Sections: make([]domain.PlannedSection, 0),
			})
		}
		key := sectionKey{module: target.ModuleCode, section: target.SectionCode}
		currentSectionIndex, sectionExists := sectionIndex[key]
		if !sectionExists {
			currentSectionIndex = len(modules[currentModuleIndex].Sections)
			sectionIndex[key] = currentSectionIndex
			modules[currentModuleIndex].Sections = append(modules[currentModuleIndex].Sections, domain.PlannedSection{
				Code: target.SectionCode, Title: target.SectionTitle, Order: target.SectionOrder,
				Lessons: make([]domain.PlannedLesson, 0),
			})
		}
		lessonTransitions := make([]domain.TransitionKnowledge, 0)
		for _, transition := range transitions {
			if domain.TargetIdentity(transition.Target) == domain.TargetIdentity(target.Ref) {
				lessonTransitions = append(lessonTransitions, transition)
			}
		}
		section := &modules[currentModuleIndex].Sections[currentSectionIndex]
		currentLessonKey := lessonKey{module: target.ModuleCode, section: target.SectionCode, lesson: target.LessonCode}
		currentLessonIndex, lessonExists := lessonIndex[currentLessonKey]
		if !lessonExists {
			currentLessonIndex = len(section.Lessons)
			lessonIndex[currentLessonKey] = currentLessonIndex
			section.Lessons = append(section.Lessons, domain.PlannedLesson{
				Code: target.LessonCode, Title: target.LessonTitle, Excerpt: target.LessonExcerpt,
				Order: target.LessonOrder, Status: domain.LessonStatusPlanned,
				Targets:             []domain.TargetRef{target.Ref},
				Prerequisites:       append([]domain.TargetRef(nil), target.Prerequisites...),
				TransitionKnowledge: lessonTransitions,
			})
			continue
		}
		lesson := &section.Lessons[currentLessonIndex]
		lesson.Targets = appendUniqueTargets(lesson.Targets, target.Ref)
		for _, prerequisite := range target.Prerequisites {
			lesson.Prerequisites = appendUniqueTargets(lesson.Prerequisites, prerequisite)
		}
		lesson.TransitionKnowledge = append(lesson.TransitionKnowledge, lessonTransitions...)
	}
	for moduleIndex := range modules {
		module := &modules[moduleIndex]
		sort.SliceStable(module.Sections, func(left, right int) bool {
			if module.Sections[left].Order != module.Sections[right].Order {
				return module.Sections[left].Order < module.Sections[right].Order
			}
			return module.Sections[left].Code < module.Sections[right].Code
		})
		for sectionIndex := range module.Sections {
			section := &module.Sections[sectionIndex]
			sort.SliceStable(section.Lessons, func(left, right int) bool {
				if section.Lessons[left].Order != section.Lessons[right].Order {
					return section.Lessons[left].Order < section.Lessons[right].Order
				}
				return section.Lessons[left].Code < section.Lessons[right].Code
			})
			for lessonIndex := range section.Lessons {
				lesson := &section.Lessons[lessonIndex]
				lesson.Targets = domain.SortTargetRefs(lesson.Targets)
				lesson.Prerequisites = domain.SortTargetRefs(lesson.Prerequisites)
				selected, err := strategies.Select(policy.PedagogyStrategies, pedagogy.LessonContext{
					Targets: lesson.Targets, TransitionKnowledge: lesson.TransitionKnowledge,
					SelfAssessedExperience: profile.SelfAssessedExperience,
				})
				if err != nil {
					return domain.GeneratedCourse{}, err
				}
				lesson.PedagogyStrategies = selected
			}
		}
	}
	sort.SliceStable(modules, func(left, right int) bool {
		if modules[left].Order != modules[right].Order {
			return modules[left].Order < modules[right].Order
		}
		return modules[left].Code < modules[right].Code
	})
	return domain.GeneratedCourse{
		Fingerprint: fingerprint, FingerprintVersion: domain.CourseFingerprintVersion,
		GoalCode: graph.Goal.Code, GoalVersion: graph.Goal.Version, Title: graph.Goal.Title,
		Description: graph.Goal.Description, Language: profile.PreferredLanguage,
		Status: domain.CourseStatusActiveBuilding, CatalogVisible: false, PlannerVersion: policy.PlannerVersion,
		PedagogyProfile: policy.PedagogyProfile, PresentationStyle: policy.PresentationStyle,
		GenerationPolicy: policy.GenerationPolicy, Modules: modules,
	}, nil
}

func appendUniqueTargets(inputs []domain.TargetRef, candidate domain.TargetRef) []domain.TargetRef {
	identity := domain.TargetIdentity(candidate)
	for _, input := range inputs {
		if domain.TargetIdentity(input) == identity {
			return inputs
		}
	}
	return append(inputs, candidate)
}
